title: Guarantor
summary: GUAR'ANTOR, noun gar'antor. A warrantor; one who engages to see that the stipulations of another are performed; also, one who engages to secure another in any right or possession.

inlines.v: GUAR'ANTOR, noun gar'antor. A warrantor; one who engages to see that the stipulations of another are performed; also, one who engages to secure another in any right or possession.
